question.instructions: What is the user asking the trading assistant to do?

criteria.list_symbols: The user wants to know which symbols or how much history is loaded, not to see any particular chart or number
criteria.market_summary: The user wants one line per symbol showing how the whole board moved, with no single symbol singled out
criteria.plot_price: The user wants to look at one symbol's price over time as a chart
criteria.intraday_pattern: The user asks how a typical trading day goes for one symbol - what happens at the open, at midday, into the close
criteria.compare_returns: The user wants two or more symbols on the same chart to see which did better
criteria.rolling_correlation: The user wants to see how closely two symbols have been moving together, and how that has changed
criteria.summary_stats: The user wants a table of numbers for one symbol - highs, lows, average move, total return
criteria.volatility: The user asks how volatile, choppy, or risky one symbol has been
criteria.top_movers: The user wants a ranked list of which symbols rose or fell the most
criteria.drawdown: The user asks how far one symbol fell from a peak, its worst decline

standard_answer.note: 按用户规则默认采用五轮稳定 Jev 基线；未作人工验证
